author: piratewithgun
body:
So I planned this map and wanted to build it with Merp (Passata) because he is good with voxel and world edit but on our first building session he crashed alexanderjoe’s build server. Whenever we try to join, the server crashes but Toby (TwentyOneTobys) let me use his account to build this map. So first up thanks to Merp for teaching me everything with regards to voxel and thanks to Toby for the account. I got a bit of help towards the end of the build from Toby (Dereban) and Phil (Phil_the_boss) so thanks to you guys too.

Features:

Teams Orange vs Purple. These colours suite the map with the lava and mycelium.

The points will change colour as they are being capped and when a team has 100% control of a point, the beacon will also change colour to indicate this. 

Each team has a new spawn point for every point they capture. 

 

About the map:

2nd point is on a raised platform meaning that players can defend that point and shoot into mid from a defensive position. The high 2nd point also means that the points alternate from high to low ground across the map, which means teams will always be competing uphill or downhill for the next capture point. Although there are areas for cover in the area surrounding mid, actually capping mid would be very difficult considering the many high archer spots bordering the map. To balance this, mid is accessible using a tunnel/mine that starts at each teams central boulder and meets under mid. Using bridges, paths, and parkour players can make their way around the edge of the map and controlling the archer spawners will be key in getting map control. 

 

I chose the name because the layers of the mountains as well as the lava reminded me of how fossils are formed and I just like that as a name anyway.

 

Pictures:

http://imgur.com/a/GtRPt

I used various packs while screen-shooting the map but about half of them are in default.

Prodigy is doing the xml for me currently.

Download soon.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
The map looks like It'd be great for gameplay however...

The pics.

- Do better quality with smooth lighting and fancy textures
You may not be able to run it, but you're only doing it for pics so it doesn't really effect you as you're using it to get good lighting.

It allows us to better identify contours and map layout due to the picture

- Use default texture pack
Most players will use the default texture pack. Texture packs will look good in one thing but be completely bad in another - just a tip.

Overall, I'd have to see it for myself to get a solid opinion...
